project.name: St Peters Hospitals and Medcare Ltd Website

must: Appointment request must never imply a confirmed booking
Emergency calling must be more prominent than WhatsApp
Placeholder clinical content must remain clearly identified
avoid: Excessive animation, glass effects, and oversized novelty typography

decisions.decision: Use the user-selected Modern Specialist Care direction
decisions.details: Crisp white and pale blue surfaces, deep navy structure, cyan interaction accents, editorial healthcare photography, compact professional typography, and restrained motion.

decisions.decision: Use 21st references as structural inspiration only
decisions.details: Adapted modern hero, doctor profile, About, and contact-hub hierarchy without live chat, ratings, or full booking behavior.

decisions.decision: Align the visual system with the supplied official logo
decisions.details: Moved the palette to deep forest and leaf greens, integrated the supplied St Peters Hospitals and Medcare Ltd mark, and paired Source Serif 4 display type with Manrope body type for a warmer clinical identity.

decisions.decision: Adopt the 21st centered navigation and mobile sheet pattern
decisions.details: The 21st Centered Nav Header reference informed the desktop hierarchy, 44px-plus targets, dimmed overlay, focus restoration, and right-side mobile navigation sheet.
